description:
FOUND s509 (Fable, 2026-10-06) by the review probes for s508a; PRE-EXISTING on main (fee16466 and b43188b5) and unchanged
by that batch.

REPRODUCER (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s509/review/misc/ce.pl):
  use constant A => 5; use constant N => 13;
  print A + N, " ", eval(q{ A + N }), " ", eval(q{ A() + N }), " ", eval(q{ (A) + N }), " ", eval(q{ N + A }), "\n";
  sub plain() { 7 } print plain + N, " ", eval(q{ plain + N }), "\n";
    perl: 18 18 18 18 18 / 20 20          PCL: 18 5 18 18 13 / 20 7
So at FILE level the empty prototype makes the name a term (`A + N` is a sum); in the eval text the same name is parsed
as a list operator and swallows what follows as its argument, which the constant then ignores.

CAUSE (not read; the measurement that discriminates): the eval text is compiled without the enclosing file's
empty-prototype facts.  `Pl::Environment::proto_is_zero_arg` is the one predicate (#365, s438c) and it answers from the
CURRENT document's declarations and from prototypes merged across a `use`; a string eval's compile starts from neither.
CHEAP MEASUREMENT (not taken): `eval q{ sub q0() { 3 } q0 + N }` (declared INSIDE the eval text) -- if that is 16, the
classifier works in eval mode and only the hand-over of the outer file's zero-arg names is missing; the IMAGE can answer it
at eval time (a defined sub with an empty prototype), which is how eval-mode name resolution already asks about captures.

BREAKING CASE to probe before fixing: `eval q{ f + 1 }` for an ordinary `sub f { "@_" }` (no prototype) must stay a call
with the argument +1.

PRIORITY: medium-low (silent wrong; constants in generated code strings: `eval "DEBUG + \$n"`, `eval "PI * 2"`).
subject: SILENT WRONG: inside a STRING EVAL a constant (any sub with an empty prototype) is not a TERM -- `eval q{ A + N }` is A (the `+ N` becomes its argument), perl 18; `eval q{ N + A }` is N; the same text at file level is right
